# Spring Roof Inspection Checklist for Homeowners

Inspect flashing, gutters, visible shingles, attic moisture, and drainage after winter. Document issues and schedule repairs before leaks spread.

## Start with a visual ground check

Walk around the property and look for missing shingles, sagging lines, blocked gutters, and visible debris.

## Check problem zones

Pay close attention to flashing, valleys, roof penetrations, and previous repair areas.

## Watch for moisture signs indoors

Look for stains, mold, soft drywall, or attic condensation.

## When to call a professional

If you notice recurring leaks, storm damage, or structural movement, schedule a professional inspection.
